selection_policy.source: This entire round comes from a freshly read Liked Songs pool. Validate saved source identities, including Spotify market relinks, before publication. A global Like is not a party Keep.
selection_policy.grove: Upbeat, fun, happy, hopeful, loving/new beginnings; bouncy, melodic and sexy. No acid/techno; avoid chart-pop-heavy discovery and sad central narratives. Familiar club crossovers remain audition risks, not automatic exceptions.
selection_policy.hollow: High energy, bouncy, hard, dark, fast underground rave; acid/hard dance/rave plus limited DnB, fast bass, leftfield and darker tech house from the current source pool.
selection_policy.separation: Distinct rooms and moods; no duplicate recordings across rooms. Review order is not final mix order.
selection_policy.evidence_limit: Source preference, party votes, lyric themes, catalog descriptors and actual-file analysis remain separate. No complete lyric or listening certification.

selection_method: User-requested source reset: choose only current Liked Songs after all prior party reviews and the old bedroom pool are excluded. Refresh selected exact US catalog identities/playability; verify original saved identities for market-relinked recordings. Use completed votes and room briefs to select/interleave individual recordings with artist/album caps. Personal source export and membership proofs remain ignored.

feedback_basis.interpretation: Latest batch kept 10/50: hard bounce/electro 4/21, acid/driving techno 3/17, rave/trance 3/10, psytrance 0/2. Follow the exact individual successes without producer-wide assumptions. The user asks to return to already Liked Songs; hard-limit this round to refreshed source membership, restoring four DnB and three darker tech-house choices from that pool. No dedicated psy lane this time; preserve all earlier Keeps.

audit.listening_status: Exact catalog identities and source gate checked; no complete audio audition, acoustic identity proof or rendered mix.

privacy_note: Full source-library exports, per-track membership/save timestamps, OAuth data, feedback backups and complete lyric texts stay ignored. Portable candidates have no individual saved flags or lyric transcripts. Artist genres are dated catalog evidence, not measured track genres.
